title: NERC 2025 State of Reliability Overview — Phase 65 Toronto application 24 254930 delivery review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the Toronto application 24 254930 delivery reporting pack. NERC's review of 2024 bulk-power performance reports improving frequency response in Texas and the West, one operator-initiated load-shed event, and early evidence of substantial battery contributions to frequency services.
key_findings: NERC reports one operator-initiated load-shed event in 2024, restored in half an hour.
Texas battery capacity increased from 1,307 MW in January 2022 to 10,027 MW in December 2024.
Batteries supplied up to 100 percent of frequency-regulation capacity in several ERCOT instances and more than 70 percent of response in individual disturbances.
why_it_matters: Which records separate Council adoption and infrastructure context from enactment, conditions, building permit, start, completion, and occupancy? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. This record advances grid, water, storage, and minerals infrastructure performance from upstream activity into a named operating, measurement, or explicit comparison-boundary record.
ftfn_relevance: Adds one of eight Phase 55Z records for grid, water, storage, and minerals infrastructure performance.
Keeps unit, period, geography, and method attached to the reported result.
Identifies the next record needed before any cross-system comparison.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
NERC calls the battery evidence initial and continues to monitor it.
Bulk-power performance does not measure distribution reliability or individual utility service.
